features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

hardware: four AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each) in us-east-2 via SkyPilot (infra/aws/sky_ctx3_head.yaml, sky_ctx3_worker.yaml; clusters prc-ctx3a-d); tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --device cuda, float32 with TF32 matrix products; two lanes per GPU; every run of this declaration on that hardware
prior_evidence: Round 2 (configs/adsb_ctx2_design_v1.json): wider window, wider token encoder and self-attention do not help; 24 epochs chosen (+0.154 pts on 2 seeds), confirmed in round A's development (e24_s65 -0.152% vs v27). Error budget (docs/adsb_ctx/error_budget_v28.json): unmatched non-LIRF rows carry 29% of development SSE (LTFM 10.5%, LFPG 9.5%, EGLL 4.7%), matched rows 15%.

protocol.aux: a linear head on the backbone's last hidden layer predicts z = clip((log1p(max(x, 0)) - mean) / std, -5, 5) of the four declared quantities (mean/std over matched fitting rows) on masked rows only; loss = main MSE + 0.3 x mean squared auxiliary error over finite entries.
protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design: the round-1/2 design fold exactly (seasonal fit partition 2025-02..06, 08, 09 without LIRF; October monitored; October predictions only)
protocol.decision: An item is GO when (a) its R2 at b = 0.5 is at least 0.05 points below ref's R2 at b = 0.5, (b) its 4-seed standalone October non-LIRF RMSE is below ref's, and (c) the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval (tools/nn_design_report.day_interval, October days) of the proxy RMSE difference between the item's and ref's tables at b = 0.5 lies below zero. Otherwise NO-GO. GO items go to a development round declared separately (hardware named) against the incumbent with the unchanged development rule; if two or more items are GO, a separately declared GPU combination batch on this fold precedes it.
protocol.masking: training only: each fitted row with adsb_matched = 1 is drawn with probability p at every step (a generator of its own) and shown as an unmatched row: the 21 declared focal-flight ADS-B columns NaN (what every unmatched row carries) and adsb_matched 0; its label is unchanged. Neighbour (nb_*, sfc_*) columns and context tokens are unchanged. Prediction never masks.
protocol.never_read: No run of this declaration predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or the ranking months.

readings.R1: October non-LIRF RMSE of every run and of each item's 4-seed mean; matched / unmatched; unmatched by airport (descriptive except as used below)
readings.R2: recipe proxy (tools/nn_design_report.RecipeProxy, all 183,761 October rows; LIRF rows at v9) of table = 0.25 committee + 0.75 net with net = (1 - b) P + b X, b in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}, as % RMSE against net = P. X = an item's 4-seed mean.
readings.items: every variant other than ref (final weights), compared with ref (final weights) on the same seeds 1-4; and the two readouts of ref (ref_ema, ref_tail) compared with ref's final weights. Other variants' readouts are descriptive.
readings.pool: P = 0.5 x mean(ctx seeds 101-116) + 0.5 x mean(ctx_e24 seeds 117-132): their seasonal-fold October stop predictions (runs/adsb_ctx/ctx_s1xx/seasonal/stop_predictions.parquet; the same fit partition as the design fold), i.e. v28/v29's network table on October.

protocol.readouts: every run also saves an EMA of its parameters (decay min(0.9995, (1 + t) / (10 + t)) at update t) and the mean of its end-of-epoch parameters over the last 6 epochs, and predicts October with each; the readouts never influence training.

purpose: GPU sprint (user: 'yes launch the gpu sprint'; four L40S, infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20260926.json): do training-time masking of the focal flight's own ADS-B inputs (with or without auxiliary heads that predict the hidden taxi path, stopped time, stops and slow start), a wider or deeper tabular branch, wider numeric embeddings, a longer budget, a higher learning rate, or weight-averaged readouts (EMA, end-of-training mean) improve the context network beyond round A's ctx_e24 settings? October design fold only, before any development score of these variants.
smoke: a code-path smoke on a GPU node (--limit-rows 20000, one epoch, an undeclared scratch config, output runs/adsb_ctx3/smoke) precedes the runs and is not a reading

tokens.data/ctx/tokens_v1: round-1 build (K 128, [-60, +30] min, centre -15 min), rebuilt on the head node by tools/build_ctx_tokens.py and copied to the workers; content hashes must equal the local manifest on every node
